g.text: 32 warmups; 2,000 measured ticks, except 1,000 at N = 1,024. Fixed 8-byte payloads; 1,400-byte packet limit.

g.text: Eligible preparation is O(F + B + R). Flushing N independent records to N recipients still emits quadratic bytes.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #787466

g.text: Packet capture/copy is timed; output hashing is outside the timer. This is not a UDP or bandwidth benchmark.
